title: Fastned - Kia e-Soul 64 kWh (2020-2024) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (e-Soul 64 kWh (2020 - 2024), charger class 150+), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
